topics.purpose: After fully characterizing the spectral redirect, decide the next genuinely-new bridge step or confirm bio-gating.
topics.question: The bridge has now fully characterized the spectral direction with verified+adversarially-checked certificates: (1) codon space = V4^3, H(3,4) Krawtchouk eigenspaces E0..E3 [dims 1,9,27,27; lambda 9,5,1,-3], H3=E3 canonical lambda=-3 (certified). (2) Bio's B*_Q6 translation-residual basis (9 within-synonymous contrasts, bio-intrinsic, support = the 13 R-codons) is REFUTED to concentrate in E3 (T3=0.40 < matched-synonymous null 0.53, z=-5.6) — the highest-frequency eigenspace does NOT host the residual. (3) Instead B*_Q6 is CERTIFIED concentrated in E1 = lambda=5, the FIRST-ORDER / single-position / additive eigenspace (z=+7.94 vs matched null). (4) That first-order excess is CERTIFIED localized to codon position 3 (wobble, z=8.76) + position 1 (z=4.53, from 6-fold-family cross-box contrasts), and to the weak/strong (z=10.05) + purine/pyrimidine (z=3.47) chemical dichotomies, NOT position 2 or keto/amino. So the genetic code's translation residual is first-order/additive (wobble + base-pairing), not the lambda=-3 the redirect hoped. Bio's cross-ORGANISM data is non-resolving at 12-16 organisms. QUESTIONS (anti-numerology, no vacuous mining): (A) Is there a NON-CIRCULAR, NON-VACUOUS bridge step that connects this bio FIRST-ORDER finding BACK to the Window6/Fibonacci math — e.g. compute Window6's OWN spectral order (is the Fibonacci-cube / Window6 constraint first-order-dominated or higher-order?) and test whether it MATCHES (alignment) or CONTRAVARIES (extends the certified inverse-analogy) the bio first-order home — given Window6 (21 vertices, 38 edges) and H(3,4) (64 vertices) are DIFFERENT graphs so a common spectral frame must be justified, not assumed? If well-posed, give the exact object + statistic + pre-registered null + what 'certified' vs 'coincidence' means. (B) If (A) is ill-posed or vacuous, is the bridge now correctly BIO-GATED (the decisive next input being an expanded organism set for the held-out cross-organism gate), and is there ANY remaining pure-math/public-data step at all? Be brutally honest: if the structural program is genuinely exhausted, say so.
